tasks.label: android: 构建并安装 Flutter debug APK
tasks.command: export ANDROID_SERIAL="$("${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/adb_target.sh")"; [ -n "$ANDROID_SERIAL" ] || { echo '无法确定唯一调试设备，已中止'; exit 1; }; flutter build apk --debug && adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk

tasks.label: android: 启动 Flutter 应用
tasks.command: export ANDROID_SERIAL="$("${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/adb_target.sh")"; [ -n "$ANDROID_SERIAL" ] || { echo '无法确定唯一调试设备，已中止'; exit 1; }; adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -W -n com.miaotoujunshi.miaotou_app/.MainActivity

tasks.label: android: 构建安装并启动
dependsOn: android: 构建并安装 Flutter debug APK
android: 启动 Flutter 应用

tasks.label: android: 查看 Flutter logcat
tasks.command: export ANDROID_SERIAL="$("${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/adb_target.sh")"; [ -n "$ANDROID_SERIAL" ] || { echo '无法确定唯一调试设备，已中止'; exit 1; }; pid=$(adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell pidof com.miaotoujunshi.miaotou_app | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $1}'); [ -n "$pid" ] || { echo '应用未运行'; exit 1; }; adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" logcat --pid="$pid"
